Given that $\overset{―}{CE}$ is a segment, what is the measure of $∠BOE?$

$m∠BOE=$
{{field-1}}${}^{∘}$
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14190698/assets/d3ba77dd51c7d26685246304088d484144f5dcda57c424656ae305cc2ffa78ae.png)

Two angles are supplementary if their measures add up to ${180}^{∘},$ a straight angle.

Since $\overset{―}{CE}$ is a segment, we have that $∠COB$ and $∠BOE$ are supplementary. 

$$
m∠COB+m∠BOE={180}^{∘}
$$

Therefore, the measure of $∠BOE$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠BOE & ={180}^{∘}-m∠COB \\  & ={180}^{∘}-{47}^{∘} \\  & ={133}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$
